div.p: How The Auto-Info Co., Ltd. collects, uses and protects your personal data under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019).
Effective date: 1 January 2026 · Last updated: 1 January 2026

The Auto-Info Co., Ltd. ("Auto-Info", "we", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This notice explains what we collect, why we collect it, how long we keep it and the rights you have under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) ("PDPA"). It applies to this website and to the enquiries and job applications you submit through it.

div.p: Essential cookies (session and language preferences) are always active because the website cannot function without them. Optional analytics cookies are used only after you give consent through the cookie bar, and you may withdraw that consent at any time. Full detail is available in our Cookie Policy.

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers who process it on our behalf (for example, hosting and website analytics providers) and only to the extent necessary, under agreements that require them to protect it. We may also disclose data where the law requires.
Some providers may process data outside Thailand. Where this happens, we take steps to ensure the recipient is subject to adequate protection or appropriate safeguards, as required by the PDPA.
div.h2: 7. How long we keep your data (retention)

ul.li: Enquiries and quotation records — up to 5 years from the last contact, unless a contract requires longer.
Job application records — up to 12 months after the recruitment decision, unless you consent to longer retention.
Analytics data — a maximum of 14 months.

div.p: We delete or anonymise personal data once the retention period ends.
div.h2: 8. Your rights as a data subject
div.p: Under the PDPA (sections 30–36) you have the right to:

ul.li: be informed about the processing of your personal data;
access and obtain a copy of your personal data;
receive your personal data in a portable, machine-readable format;
object to the processing of your personal data;
have your data erased or anonymised where permitted;
restrict the use of your personal data;
withdraw your consent at any time; and
lodge a complaint with the Office of the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC).

div.p: To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@auto-info.co.th. We will respond within 30 days.

We apply administrative, technical and physical safeguards — including access control, encryption in transit and least-privilege access — to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration or loss. We review these measures regularly.
